title: Make-Good Caps by Fare Size for Wayfare Rides Billing Errors
content:
**Finance schedule.** The make-good paid on a **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** fare charge billed above the guaranteed fare is capped according to the size of the fare charge, read as the amount of the trip's fare charge as booked.

| Fare charge amount | Make-good cap |
|---|---|
| $75.00 or more (the large fare threshold) | $12.00 (large-fare make-good cap) |
| at least $30.00 (the mid fare threshold) and below $75.00 | $7.00 (mid-fare make-good cap) |
| below $30.00 | not raised by fare size |

A fare charge of at least $75.00 is capped at the large-fare make-good cap of $12.00; a fare charge of at least $30.00 but below $75.00 is capped at the mid-fare make-good cap of $7.00; for any smaller fare charge the cap is not raised by fare size.

## Either side of each threshold (hypothetical fare charges)

| Fare charge | Band | Cap |
|---|---|---|
| $74.99 | at least $30.00, below $75.00 | $7.00 |
| $75.00 | at least $75.00 | $12.00 |
| $29.99 | below $30.00 | not raised |
| $30.00 | at least $30.00, below $75.00 | $7.00 |

The comparison uses the fare charge amount itself, not the fare after any fare adjustment booked on the trip.
